title: Voice takes turns like a person on a call: the person talks over Tracy and it stops for two words or a stop word but goes on for 'ừ'/'okay' or a sound it cannot make out; pauses to think and still-speaking hold the send; corrections while working are steered in; question cards are asked with their choices and answered out loud; a note on a site's start screen introduces Voice
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed, a Chrome or Playwright Chromium available) run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/e2e/voice-mode.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-mode.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-turn-taking.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-answer.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-speak-text.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-mode-view.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/voice-reply.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/speech-relay.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/speech-health.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat' passes: 'Ừ ừ.' said over the reply leaves Tracy reading and sends nothing; 'Khoan đã…' over it stops Tracy and is sent; words said while Tracy works are answered 'Got it. I will work that in now.'.

'the note introducing Voice: on the start screen, its arrow on the wave; pressed it goes into Voice; closed it stays closed until a reload' passes: the note goes into Voice when pressed and the wave has no hover text.

The controller tests named below pass: 'ừ'/'okay', 'Dzuiii.' and 'Du. 2.' over Tracy are never sent; 'Huân đã, trang…' stops it; '…và' waits for the rest; a phrase is not sent while the person still speaks; a question card is answered through its own verb with the choice named; long work says 'Still working on it.'.
'what stops Tracy talking…' and 'one question: the choice named…' pass.

'in a chat that has a header the note is under its Chat/Voice button, arrow on the button; pressed it goes into Voice' passes; in the main E2E the mute button shows a microphone while listening and a crossed-out microphone when muted.

The 17/10 round passes: a choice said after Tracy read it is sent (not taken for its echo); an open card takes “ừ”; a session is not let go while the person speaks; “dừng lại” and the footer’s Stop cancel the turn and Tracy says “Stopped. Anything already saved stays.”; the acknowledgements are read when Voice starts and then played from the page’s copy; a failed turn is said; the reply’s opening paragraph is read; the host gets the spoken-reply rule only in Voice; the relay charges seconds (0, 5, 3 for 7.5 s) and asks for vad_silence_threshold_secs=0.8 only with ?turns=voice.

The checklist round (17/10) passes: “khoan đã” alone stops the work and is never a message; an unanswered question is asked once more after 12 s; one dropped connection goes on listening, two pause; a fan at 900 RMS opens at most one session; the acknowledgements alternate two wordings; laughter and “(laughs)” are not sent; the health probes tell a session_started/200 from an auth_error/401; GET /api/speech hides the microphone when speech to text refuses the key and Voice when text to speech does.

The live-site round (17/10) passes: a second reading of a finished phrase (“…thôi nhé.” then “…thôi, hả?”) is dropped by the relay, so the phrase is told once; words the service shows and never confirms go after 3 s of quiet, not when the session times out; an opening longer than 45 words is read in whole sentences up to the cap, then “the rest”; words said before the footer’s Stop — counting down or still being finished — are not sent by themselves; a choice labelled “(Recommended)” is read without the marker and picked by its name.
evidence: 16/10/2026: (translated) 'when I keep talking the agent breaks off until I finish, then it answers'; 'make me a small popup saying Use voice with Tracy here… off means off, only a reload turns it back on'; 'check carefully that it handles this like a real consultant would'. Five runs on the real dsh page with real STT/TTS and agent, screenshots and logs: tasks/evidence/voice-barge-in-2026-10-16/.
fence: createVoiceMode in packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/voice-mode.mjs (onFrame voiceOver/spokeAt, heard, armSend, notARequest, sendWords with steer and the question card, offerAck, armStill); isBackchannel/isFillerOnly/stopsTracy/soundsUnfinished in voice-turn-taking.mjs; askedLine/spokenAnswer/pendingQuestion in voice-answer.mjs; VoiceTip in VoiceMode.tsx; sendToChat mode in packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/src/client/chat-send.ts; tellVoice in voice-mode-view.mjs; spokenReply opening in voice-speak-text.mjs; readVoiceReport/voiceSessions/voiceReplyRule in packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/voice-reply.mjs and its /view door and step rule in index.ts; charge/spentAll, TURN_SILENCE_SECONDS and rereads in apps/tracy-web/src/speech/relay.js; stuckCheck in voice-mode.mjs; withinWords/SPOKEN_WORDS in voice-speak-text.mjs; stopWork in voice-mode.mjs; shownLabel in voice-answer.mjs

tests: Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat
the note introducing Voice: on the start screen, its arrow on the wave; pressed it goes into Voice; closed it stays closed until a reload
in a chat that has a header the note is under its Chat/Voice button, arrow on the button; pressed it goes into Voice
talking over Tracy: it is turned down, stops at the person’s first words, hears them out, then answers that
“ừ”, “okay” over Tracy is the person listening: Tracy goes on at its own volume, nothing is sent
a sound Tracy cannot make out over its voice: it goes on turned down, and the sound is never sent nor glued to what follows
an “ừ” begun over a short line whose words come back once Tracy is done is still listening, never sent
a phrase that stops on “và…” waits for the rest; a question goes like any phrase
a phrase due to go waits while the person is still speaking and no word of it is read yet
talking while Tracy works steers the words into the work, as a person takes in a correction, and says so
a question is asked with its choices, and the words said next answer its card
a long stretch of work with nothing said: Tracy says it is still on it, not after the person stopped its talking
what stops Tracy talking: two words or more, or one that asks it to stop — not a sound it cannot make out
one question: the choice named when that is all that was said, else the person’s own words
a choice said after Tracy read it out is the person choosing, not Tracy’s voice coming back
a question card being read: “ừ” said over it stops Tracy and answers the card
a session is never let go while the person is still speaking, even with no word read yet
“khoan đã” or “dừng lại” said alone while Tracy works stops the work; “khoan đã, để …” is a correction steered in
the footer’s Stop stops the work, as dsh’s Stop button would
the phrases said the moment words go are read when the voice starts, and then play at once
a turn that failed with nothing written is said, never silent; one the person stopped stays quiet
a reply in Voice opens with a paragraph for the ear: that is what is read, then “the rest”
the host is told when a conversation shows Voice, again while it does, and when it stops
a turn the person spoke in Voice gets the spoken-reply rule; one not in Voice, or with no words, does not
the audio received is charged in seconds — a short phrase costs its seconds, never a minute
a voice conversation asks the service for a shorter silence at the end of a phrase; dictation keeps its default
“khoan đã” alone, said over Tracy’s reply, only stops its talking: never a message
a question left unanswered is asked once more after a quiet while, then Tracy waits
the connection to the speech service dropping once goes on listening; twice pauses
a fan or air conditioning louder than the fixed threshold is the room, not the person: one session at most, then speech still opens one
a line said every time takes its wordings in turn, so Tracy does not sound like a recording
laughter and the sound tags the service writes are never a message
speech to text: a session that starts takes the key; an auth error or a 401 refuses it; nothing else says anything
text to speech: one character read takes the key; 401 refuses it with the service’s word; a busy service says nothing
the job tries the key while voice is on, notes refusals, and tries again at once when a key is saved
GET /api/speech: speech to text refused → no microphone; text to speech refused → no Voice, dictation stays
a second reading of a finished phrase is dropped too; a new phrase is not
the service reading a finished phrase again as a partial does not write it twice or hold it
words the service shows and never confirms go as heard once the person is quiet, not when the session times out
an opening longer than the voice should read is cut at a sentence; a short first one is read with the next
words counting down when the work is stopped wait for Send now; they never restart the work by themselves
a request still being finished when the work is stopped is held too; speech begun after the Stop goes as usual
a choice marked “(Recommended)” is read and named as the card shows it, and answered as written
